# Agent Python Tools

- repo: berriai/litellm
- repo_uri: https://github.com/berriai/litellm

## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/azure_ai/common_utils.py

Prompts

```
['build the Azure AI route detection for a model name returning agents, model_router, or default', 'create a function that strips the model_router or model-router prefix from an Azure AI model name', 'get the appropriate Azure AI config class for a given model name based on routing rules', 'create a token counter factory for Azure AI that returns AzureAIAnthropicTokenCounter for Claude models', 'get the Azure AI API base URL from parameter, litellm global, or AZURE_AI_API_BASE environment variable', 'test the _is_azure_model_router function to detect Azure AI Foundry Model Router model names', 'calculate the flat routing cost for Azure AI Foundry Model Router based on prompt tokens', 'calculate the prompt and completion cost in USD for Azure AI models including model router flat cost']
```

Usage

```
{'build_azure_ai_route': 'build the Azure AI route detection for a model name returning agents, model_router, or default', 'create_strip_model_router_prefix': 'create a function that strips the model_router or model-router prefix from an Azure AI model name', 'get_azure_ai_config_for_model': 'get the appropriate Azure AI config class for a given model name based on routing rules', 'create_get_token_counter': 'create a token counter factory for Azure AI that returns AzureAIAnthropicTokenCounter for Claude models', 'get_azure_ai_api_base': 'get the Azure AI API base URL from parameter, litellm global, or AZURE_AI_API_BASE environment variable'}
```


Usage

```

```
